_note: Key-art prompts for the treetop scene (tools/keyart.py). Wide 16:9 so the plate needs no crop. Keep the camera locked-off and leave room for rain/leaf/lantern animation.

items.prompt: Wide 16:9 cinematic screenshot of a cozy Minecraft treehouse in autumn, viewed from inside the treehouse looking out over a wooden balcony railing at a great view: a valley of blocky orange, red and gold autumn trees, a winding river and lake, and snow-capped blocky mountains in the distance under a warm sunset sky with soft pink clouds. Inside: dark oak plank floor and log walls, a red wool carpet in the foreground, a wooden chest, a small bookshelf, glowing lanterns on the railing posts and hanging from the ceiling, potted flowers, and autumn leaf blocks with hanging vines framing the top of the view. Shader-pack lighting with soft volumetric god rays, warm bloom, soft shadows and realistic reflections on the water. Locked-off camera at eye level, no people, no text, no user interface.
